Lounge Access Terms and Conditions
The Cardholder is entitled to 8 lounge visits (Cardholder only) in a calendar year

To be eligible for the complete entitlement of 8 visits, the Cardholder needs to complete one (1) international transaction in each calendar year (Minimum transaction value of USD 1 at Point of Sale transactions including Face to Face, E Commerce, MOTO or Recurring transactions where Issuer is not located in the country of transaction; Spend may take up to 15 days to register with LoungeKey)
The Cardholders will be initially assigned one (1) complimentary visit each year prior to meeting the Eligibility Condition
Annual lounge visit entitlement and the requirement to meet the eligibility condition will reset from 1 Jan in subsequent years
As part of the default option, any lounge visits outside Visa Lounge entitlement will need to be paid for by the Cardholder (Visit will be charged directly to the card by LoungeKey)

Any payment towards the credit card within the loan period first pays off any Equal Monthly Instalments (EMI) due in the month ,then, all fees and interest are cleared, followed by 1% of the Balance Transfer outstanding, 1% if the Smart Payment Plan outstanding and 1% of retail outstanding in that order.
The remaining amount of payment will go towards clearing 100% of the Retail outstanding followed by Balance Transfer and Smart Payment plan.

The interest rate applied on the Balance Transfer outstanding amount shall be 0% (Zero %), for a period of six months from approval of the application, where after the period of six months the prevailing base interest rate will apply. All other outstanding on the credit card account shall continue being levied interest at the prevailing interest rate.

It is important to set the monthly “Minimum Amount Due” payment at less than 100% to avail the lower interest rate. Otherwise 100% of the outstanding will be cleared when the standing instruction is executed.
